source: corresponding-source at commit 94d09e5a72aa8d1c9859d02ca0c3c98098f361a5 (A14 Pomodoro branding update), built with electron-vite and run unpackaged with Electron 44.7.2
platform: Linux x64 under Xvfb, device scale factor 2. The Windows interface fonts are not available there; fontconfig maps Segoe UI to Selawik, the open-source Segoe UI fallback published by Microsoft. Windows rendering may differ slightly.
data: Isolated fictional profile in a disposable directory. History comes from the application's own demo-data generator (Settings, Open demo data), copied into an ordinary profile; three subject names were changed to generic ones. The Building Physics sessions, recall notes, follow-up, log answers, rest and backup were performed live through the interface during capture. No personal records were used.
method: Playwright drove the real windows and took viewport or element captures. Pixels inside application windows are unedited. The README images in assets/readme are built from these files by assets/readme/build_images.py, which only crops, scales, rounds corners and places captures on a backdrop. The hero image places a floating-panel capture beside a Home capture taken a few minutes earlier.
notReleased: These screens show current development source. The published FocusRecall Beta 1 and Beta 2 binaries keep their original branding.
